name: Anquela del Ducado (Spain)
description: A yellow triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre of the fly, the fly divided horizontally blue over red.
history: Municipal flag of Anquela del Ducado; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre of the fly
